explication: Vaultwarden is a self-hosted Bitwarden-compatible API server. Official clients send authenticated requests to Rocket routes, which validate identity and security requirements, execute vault, sharing, organization, Send, emergency-access, or administration operations, persist state, and return JSON results. Optional flows integrate with SMTP, push services, Duo, OIDC, WebAuthn, website-icon providers, and S3-compatible storage. The graph emphasizes documented capabilities and sampled module boundaries; several route implementations were not inspected, so unsupported internal call chains are omitted.
